How to read this report

Net invoice sales comes from the bill-wise reports and includes tax/adjustments. Medicine/item sales is the item report's AMOUNT column and may differ due to taxes, discounts and other adjustments. These totals must never be added together.

The item report has no transaction dates; dates are obtained by matching invoice numbers to the bill-wise reports. Unmatched item rows appear in unfiltered all-time medicine totals but cannot be assigned to a month or date-filtered analysis.

Quantity means the report's QTY column; the adjacent second integer is treated as free quantity. Item amounts do not always equal RATE × QTY because of invoice-level/item-level adjustments. Do not infer profits, margins, stock on hand, expiry, collections or outstanding receivables from these reports.

Customers with spelling differences may appear separately. Product names and pack sizes are used as printed; this does not merge equivalent medicines with different descriptions.

Import and validation notes

Patwardhan Pharma Distributors · Offline analytics · For management review, not a replacement for billing, accounting, GST or stock reconciliation. Validate representative invoices and period totals against Sunonline software.
